note: Real export shipments confirmed, but they are two land-border consignments on a single date (2024-05-19) to one Nepali buyer (Shivam Dairy and Food Industries), i.e. one-off equipment supply, not a recurring export flow. The company is a dairy/food-processing machinery maker, not metallurgy/mining as claimed in the brief.
